description: This file contains unit tests for the I18NGroupAPI class within the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifically testing API endpoints related to I18N (Internationalization) groups in the admin module.

classes.name: I18NGroupAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the I18NGroupAPI endpoints in the OrangeHRM system, including tests for retrieving all groups and handling unimplemented create and delete operations.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' API endpoint for retrieving all I18N groups, utilizing data providers for multiple test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for 'testGetAll' method from the YAML configuration 'I18NGroupAPITestCase.yml'.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that calling 'create' on the API throws a 'Not Implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that calling 'getValidationRuleForCreate' throws a 'Not Implemented' exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that calling 'delete' on the API throws a 'Not Implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that calling 'getValidationRuleForDelete' throws a 'Not Implemented' exception.
